newsitem.title: ISRAEL: No charges against Netanyahu - spokesman.
newsitem.headline: No charges against Netanyahu - spokesman.

text.p: Israeli prosecutors will not charge Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in a corruption scandal, his spokesman said on Sunday.
Asked if it was correct the Israeli leader would not be indicted, his communications chief David Bar-Illan told Reuters: "That's right."

A government official said only one of the four officials who police recommended be charged over the short-lived appointment of an attorney general would be indicted -- Shas party leader and coalition ally Aryeh Deri.

"Also the language is only very mildly critical as far as I know. I haven't been able to read the whole thing yet. But from the report I got, it's a very mild criticism. I have looked at it cursorily," the official said minutes before prosecutors were due to make their decision public.
"Both (Justice Minister) Tzachi Hanegbi and the prime minister are completely in the clear on the ministerial level," the official told Reuters.
